name: MSAA Voxelization
aliases: Conservative Rasterization with MSAA render target
definition: A technique to achieve conservative rasterization without expanding primitive edges in the Geometry Shader. It uses MSAA (Multi-Sampling Anti-Aliasing) to invoke the pixel shader if any subsample is covered by a primitive.
summary: MSAA Voxelization approximates conservative rasterization using hardware MSAA coverage tests, avoiding explicit edge expansion and linked lists by invoking the pixel shader once per covered pixel.
